title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array
description: Remove duplicates from a sorted array in-place and return the new length.

data.text: Given a sorted array `nums`, remove duplicates in-place so that each unique element appears only once. Return the new length.
Insert elements into a HashSet to deduplicate, then copy back. O(n) time, O(n) space.

data.title: Extra Set O(n)
data.content: Use a HashSet to deduplicate, then copy unique elements back.

data.text: Use a write pointer to overwrite duplicates in-place. Since the array is sorted, duplicates are adjacent. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Two-Pointer O(n)
data.content: Use a write pointer to overwrite duplicates in-place.

data.title: What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n) both ways. **Space:** O(n) → O(1). The two-pointer approach leverages the sorted property and does the work in-place.
